title: Humpback Whales Interrupt Orca Attacks to Protect Other Animals

scenes.text: Humpbacks rush in when orcas attack.
A study reviewed 62 years of records, 115 interactions.
In about 89 percent, the orcas were hunting other animals.
Humpbacks were seen shielding seals and even an ocean sunfish.
Nobody knows for sure why they do it.
Whales that fight orcas for animals that aren't even whales.

description:
A study of 62 years of records found 115 interactions between humpbacks and orcas, and in about 89 percent the orcas were hunting other animals.
Humpbacks were seen protecting seals and even an ocean sunfish.
Why do you think they do it?
first_comment: Why do you think humpbacks protect other animals?
